description: This file contains utility functions and constants for CRUD operations in the Superset frontend, including data fetching, error handling, deletion handlers, and UI styling.

methods.name: createFetchResourceMethod
methods.description: Creates a function to fetch resources from the API with specified method, handling pagination and user info.

methods.name: getParams
methods.description: Encodes filters and columns into a rison query string for API requests.

methods.name: getEditedObjects
methods.description: Fetches recent dashboards and charts edited by a specific user.

methods.name: getUserOwnedObjects
methods.description: Retrieves objects owned by a specific user.

methods.name: getFilteredChartsandDashboards
methods.description: Fetches charts and dashboards based on filters, with error handling.

methods.name: getRecentActivityObjs
methods.description: Gets recent activity objects for a user, combining recent views with filtered charts/dashboards.

methods.name: createFetchRelated
methods.description: Creates a fetch function for related resources.

methods.name: createFetchDistinct
methods.description: Creates a fetch function for distinct resource values.

methods.name: createFetchOwners
methods.description: Fetches owners for a resource, formatting results with labels and emails.

methods.name: createErrorHandler
methods.description: Generates an error handler that logs errors and displays user-friendly messages.

methods.name: handleChartDelete
methods.description: Handles deletion of a chart, with success/error toasts and data refresh.

methods.name: handleDashboardDelete
methods.description: Handles deletion of a dashboard, with success/error toasts and optional data refresh.

methods.name: shortenSQL
methods.description: Shortens SQL string to a specified number of lines, appending ellipsis if needed.

methods.name: getPasswordsNeeded
methods.description: Extracts files requiring passwords from error objects.

methods.name: getSSHPasswordsNeeded
methods.description: Extracts files requiring SSH passwords from error objects.

methods.name: getSSHPrivateKeysNeeded
methods.description: Extracts files requiring SSH private keys from error objects.

methods.name: getSSHPrivateKeyPasswordsNeeded
methods.description: Extracts files requiring SSH private key passwords from error objects.

methods.name: getAlreadyExists
methods.description: Extracts files that already exist error info from error objects.

methods.name: hasTerminalValidation
methods.description: Checks if errors require terminal validation based on error types.

methods.name: checkUploadExtensions
methods.description: Checks if user permissions include allowed upload extensions.

methods.name: uploadUserPerms
methods.description: Determines user permissions for uploading different file types based on roles and allowed extensions.

methods.name: getFilterValues
methods.description: Generates filter values for different table views based on tab, user, and other filters.
